title: The Lenches Fireworks Night — The Lenches Club
body: Save the date: the club's annual Fireworks Night is back, and bigger than ever. Doors open at 5pm and the professional display, fired from the cricket ground, starts at 7.30pm, so arrive early for a good spot. There's a burger van, pork baps and a pick and mix stall, sparklers and glow bands for the children, apple bobbing, drinks deals at the bar from 6pm and a disco after the fireworks. Entry is free and no membership is needed; cash and card are welcome at every stall. Donations on the night go towards the club's building and renovation work.
